# Rishab Advani

> Rishab Advani works in growth and strategy. He has seven-plus years in enterprise SaaS, strategy execution and client management at BMC Software, and built two ventures from zero before that. He is now at Masters' Union (PGP in Technology & Business Management, Gurgaon), where he co-founded RecoveryCo and took it to ₹5.5M in orders in three months.

Key facts:

- 7+ years in SaaS and client management, around BMC Software's enterprise ITSM products (Associate Product Developer, 2021 to 2026, Pune; earlier through Manpower Group, 2019 to 2021)
- $3M in SaaS upsell revenue at BMC, from product demos and requirement gathering for on-prem clients
- ₹1 Cr+ in revenue built from zero at Hawk-Eye Aerial, a drone-video company he co-founded
- ₹5.5M in orders in three months at RecoveryCo, at a 7.0 average ROAS and a 41% EBITDA margin
- Strengths: go-to-market and pricing strategy, root cause analysis, stakeholder and escalation management, process automation, data-driven decision making
- Currently studying in Gurgaon (Masters' Union); earlier work in Pune
- Contact: rishab.advani2027@mastersunion.org (email is the quickest way to reach him)

## Case studies

- [RecoveryCo: ₹5.5M in orders in three months](https://rishab-advani.vercel.app/#recoveryco): co-founded dropshipping store at Masters' Union (Jul to Sep 2026). Owned go-to-market and pricing; 41% EBITDA margin on ₹16.6L processed revenue, 7.0 average ROAS, return-to-origin cut from 40% to 24%
- [BMC Software: client sign-off cut by 70% with one migration utility](https://rishab-advani.vercel.app/#migration): analysed 100+ Jira tickets, automated 90+ data checks into one utility, raised monthly SaaS migrations 33%, drove $3M in SaaS upsell revenue
- [BMC Software: weekly escalations cut from 25 to under 10](https://rishab-advani.vercel.app/#escalations): root-cause fixes, retained a ~$15M credit-card client with a PCI-masking plugin, supported 25+ enterprise accounts, go-to security SME for the Helix platform
- [Hawk-Eye Aerial: a drone-video business built to ₹1 Cr+](https://rishab-advani.vercel.app/#hawk-eye): co-founder (Dec 2015 to Jul 2017). Opened 30+ B2B accounts by cold calls and LinkedIn InMail, retained 30% of accounts, led a 3-member team
- [Shoperbucks: zero to ₹70 lakh a month](https://rishab-advani.vercel.app/#shoperbucks): business consultant for an online marketplace (Jan 2015 to Jul 2017). Pricing strategy grew revenue to ₹70L a month; sale events on Snapdeal and Amazon lifted conversion 2.5x
